title: The Stars, the Boy, and the Piano
overview: Shang-Hsuan, a gifted pianist with autism, is about to enter senior high school. A piano competition may be his only chance to prove his extraordinary talent. His mother and sister guide him through every step required to take the stage. What seems effortless to others becomes a Sisyphus-like trial, testing the family?s love, patience, and faith in a miracle.
